panels.figure_caption: Selected axial (A + B) and coronal (C) abdomen CT scan with intravenous contrast images were done for our patient . They are showing a focal and oval shaped area of omental haziness is located along the anteromedial aspect of the ascending colon near the ileocecal valve (green arrow in A image and yellow star in C image), measuring 4.9 × 3.3 × 2.7 cm in craniocaudal, anteroposterior and transverse diameters respectively . Its associated with wall thickening of the adjacent part of ileocecal valve (blue star in B image). Note the small omental vessels entering the center of the haziness area (blue arrow in A image). These finding are suggestive of omental infarction.
